vocab.description: Vocabulary 4.1: full review — split cards, removed duplicates, corrected meanings, new sentences, usage notes

changes: Phones: while typing, Easy / Default / Hard and Next (or Check) share one row, so Next is no longer hidden behind the keyboard
Vocabulary 4.1: every card reviewed — 69 cards with two meanings split into two cards, 132 junk or duplicate cards removed, 1,127 meanings corrected or completed
New example sentences for 833 cards, so that the English sentence always contains the word
Usage notes (e.g. “ne … pas”, “être au courant”) are shown only after you answer, so they no longer give the answer away
Writing: the French correct answer now shows its gender and article (n.f. — la …) or verb forms
Writing in English: any one of the meanings is correct (“to adore, to love”: “love”)
